brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Three cells in a row (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:-1,0,0;full) each fitted with hex-acc-keyhole on the rear face (slot 3/1/0) – lift-and-drop wall mounting.

requirements.requirement: With hooks for small hand tools
requirements.evidence: Three hook plates (hex-acc-hook accessory) on front faces: accessory:0#-1,0#1, accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4 – each plate carries two hooks for pliers, screwdrivers etc.

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell horizontal wall rack with keyhole hangers on the back for wall mounting and three hook plates on the front for small hand tools. Joints locked and open faces capped.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your wall-mounted tool rack is on the way — I'll design a clean, hook-ready strip for those hand tools.
